pacts.name: Pact of the Blade
pacts.description: Manifest the agreement in a weapon. Use a Bonus Action to conjure or bind an eligible melee weapon; gain proficiency, Charisma option for attacks and damage, and Warlock focus use; choose ordinary, Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage per attack. Follow the host's modern bond and ending restrictions.
pacts.deepenedAtLevel5: Attack twice with your Pact weapon during one Attack action; this is intrinsic and does not cost an Invocation. Devouring Blade can upgrade this to three attacks total. Thirsting Blade is not a selectable option.

pacts.name: Pact of the Chain
pacts.description: Know Find Familiar without spending an ordinary known-spell selection. Cast it as a Magic action without a slot while retaining components, or as a ritual. Use host statblocks for Imp, Pseudodragon, Quasit, Skeleton, Sphinx of Wonder, Sprite, Venomous Snake, or ordinary forms. Familiar shares initiative but takes its own turn. Forgo one of your attacks during your Attack action to command one familiar Attack action in that shared round.
pacts.deepenedAtLevel5: The familiar's one commanded Attack action contains two attacks, not two Attack actions. Investment of the Chain Master may instead use the Warlock's Bonus Action to command this same action; the routes never stack.

pacts.name: Pact of the Tome
pacts.description: Conjure a Book of Shadows at the end of a Short or Long Rest. While carrying it, gain three extra cantrips from any class list and two level-1 Ritual spells, with the book as a focus. For this alpha, starter Ritual spells are ritual-only unless separately known; replacement does not recharge limited uses. Book of Ancient Secrets separately supports additional rituals.
pacts.deepenedAtLevel5: Cast each of Animate Dead, Haste, and Call Lightning once separately without a slot per Long Rest; ordinary casting requirements and concentration apply. The book does not refresh the three uses when replaced.

pacts.name: Pact of the Talisman
pacts.description: One active wearable or transferable talisman. Untrained Guidance adds 1d4 to an unproficient skill ability check without spending charges. Fortunate Correction spends one charge after a failed ability check to add 1d4. They cannot both enhance one check, and neither applies to attacks or saving throws. Charges equal Warlock proficiency bonus and recover on Long Rest; replacing a lost talisman takes a one-hour ceremony and does not restore charges.
pacts.deepenedAtLevel5: Shared Ward: while the wearer is within 60 feet and takes damage, spend the Warlock's Reaction and one existing Talisman charge to reduce that damage event by 2d6 plus Charisma modifier, bounded between zero and the damage taken. The dedicated Talisman elective Invocations were omitted from this alpha.
